mapper.select: SELECT d.id,d.reservation_key AS reservationKey,d.buyer_kind AS buyerKind,d.buyer_id AS buyerId, d.target_draft_id AS targetDraftId,d.target_revision AS targetRevision,d.revision,d.state, d.review_status AS reviewStatus,d.publish_status AS publishStatus,d.is_sync AS isSync, LENGTH(d.source_content) AS sourceLength,LENGTH(d.terms_document) AS termsLength, CHAR_LENGTH(d.frozen_rights) AS rightsCharacterCount, CASE WHEN LENGTH(d.source_content)<=262144 THEN d.source_content ELSE NULL END AS sourceContent,CASE WHEN LENGTH(d.terms_document)<=65535 THEN d.terms_document ELSE NULL END AS termsDocument, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(d.frozen_rights)<=65536 THEN d.frozen_rights ELSE NULL END AS rightsJson,d.installed_by AS installedBy,d.installed_at AS installedAt, u.owned_draft_id AS usageOwnedDraftId,u.reservation_key AS usageReservationKey,u.committed_at AS committedAt FROM w18_module_owned_draft d JOIN w18_module_install_usage u ON u.owned_draft_id=d.id AND u.reservation_key=d.reservation_key WHERE d.id=#{owned} AND d.buyer_kind='INDIVIDUAL' AND d.buyer_id=#{actor} AND d.reservation_key=#{reservation} FOR UPDATE

SELECT draft_id AS draftId,local_key AS localKey,component_kind AS componentKind,schema_version AS schemaVersion, CHAR_LENGTH(content_json) AS contentCharacterCount,CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(content_json)<=266240 THEN content_json ELSE NULL END AS contentJson FROM w18_module_draft_component WHERE draft_id=#{owned} ORDER BY local_key LIMIT 2 FOR UPDATE
